# Runtime gaps

> Generated by `tools/` from the inputs in `source/`. Every statement below is backed by assembly metadata, IL, or a supplied export sample.
> Anything that could not be proven from those inputs is marked **Unknown** rather than guessed.

Facts that static analysis cannot settle. Each entry names what would settle it.

| Question | Why static analysis cannot answer it | What would settle it |
|---|---|---|
| Is import atomic? | Transaction scope is a control-flow property; IL was read as a flat opcode stream. | Decompile NewImportManager::Import, or trace SQL on a scratch database. |
| What happens on a duplicate object? | Create/Overwrite/Skip/Merge is decided by branches that were not reconstructed. | Import the same package twice into a scratch database and diff. |
| Are IDs preserved or regenerated on import? | $IdEmbeddingFields proves a remap step exists; whether it is identity-preserving depends on runtime state. | Import into a database with and without a colliding id. |
| What does MET_TYPEVIEWENTITY.TypeViewBlob contain? | Opaque binary column; no deserializer was identified for it. | Decompile the TypeViewEntity reader, or dump a blob and inspect. |
| What is the exact on-disk JSON export shape? | BixHelper.ExportJson exists but no JSON sample was supplied. | Produce one JSON export and add it to source/exports/samples/. |
| Which objects does the exporter deliberately skip? | Requires reading exclusion predicates, which are control flow. | Export a system with known audit/session rows and check their absence. |
| Is there a version-compatibility gate on import? | The header carries Core Version; whether the importer enforces it is a branch. | Attempt an import of a package whose Core Version differs. |
| Does the importer defer any object to a second pass? | AfterImport and RecreateForAll run late, which is consistent with deferral but does not prove it. | Decompile ImportManager_Structure, or observe insert order at runtime. |
